description: Fast positioning TU schema for NCI1: discrete node labels/degree buckets, generic cycle/degree descriptors, retained continuous node attributes, and exact S1/S2 topology. No target label or fitted statistic is part of the schema.
disconnected_policy: supported with finite statistics: unreachable pairs (shortest-path sentinel -1) are excluded from diameter/mean distance, reported via frac_unreachable_pairs, and never counted as finite distance >= 3
